purpose: Canonical (authoritative) analytical fields for Stage 6. Deprecated / non-authoritative fields may remain in raw output for compatibility but MUST NOT enter Stage 6 tables, statistical tests, or claims.

non_authoritative.discoverable_finder_count: Do NOT use for miner counts; use distinct_potential_finder_miner_count.
non_authoritative.per_miner.unsearched_count: Do NOT use for final-generation reconciliation; use per_miner_generation.
non_authoritative.per_miner.remaining_unsearched: Do NOT use for final-generation reconciliation; use per_miner_generation.

deprecated_stale_aliases.note: Use the canonical single_height_ fields when they exist.

notes: post_winner_* covers EVERY active non-winning miner; stale_producer_postwinner_* is the producer-only subset.
Legacy stale_race_candidate_evaluations / stale_race_active_time_s are defined to EQUAL the complete post_winner_* totals, not the producer subset.
B3 and C1 interpretations share ONE physical run; do not treat them as independent replications.
Post-winner diagnostic work and single-height stale diagnostics are secondary; they never enter primary energy, primary candidate counts, accepted-block counts, or canonical block interval.
